claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. There is no magic_item kind or MagicItemMechanics family. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom and attune as a procedure atom, but the surface has no corresponding record type, no mechanics header, and no mechanics family for magic items.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The headband's sole mechanical effect is setting the wearer's Intelligence to 19. This is a passive ability-score override, not covered by any existing effect atom. TAXONOMY v4 §12 explicitly lists this as out-of-scope: 'modify_ability_score as a runtime effect versus as pre-runtime character state (currently treated as out-of-scope)'. A future magic_item family would need this atom to encode the Headband of Intellect, Belt of Giant Strength, Amulet of Health, etc.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Intelligence is 19 while you wear this headband.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: attunement mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item requires attunement. The v4 taxonomy has attunement_slot (resource) and attune (procedure) atoms, but no surface type captures the attunement lifecycle for magic items (equip → attune → effect active; unequip/break attunement → effect inactive).
